# **_VerAll_**
### **every** version. one plugin. zero setup.

Supports **_Minecraft Java 1.8.8 → latest + snapshots._**  

Also supports Bedrock & Preview via Geyser.


Standalone (no ViaVersion/ProtocolLib), no config needed:
drop in /plugins, restart, done.

Features:
• Full version range support  
• Bedrock & Preview detection  
• Smart multi-layer protocol detection (no false kicks)  
• Version control (min/max, allow/deny lists)  
• Snapshot/future version handling  
• Persistent stats  
• Crash-safe event handling  
• Tiny footprint (<10KB)


```
Works on Paper, Spigot, Purpur (Java 17+).
```
